Bold Text listing copy vs typography engineering — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate system accessibility features with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Bold Text on the device — iOS applies heavier system typefaces across UI text when Bold Text is enabled. Toggle under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Bold Text. System accessibility behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • UIFont weight APIs and custom font engineering — code that detects Bold Text traits, ships custom typefaces, or adapts in-app typography when system text weight changes. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Bold Text marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app works with Bold Text, respects heavier system typefaces, or reads clearly when Bold Text is on. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Bold Text.

An app that references Bold Text in onboarding and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe heavier system typefaces and Bold Text compatibility on the store page, not whether Bold Text toggles inside iOS Settings.

Bold Text-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Heavier-typeface marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Bold Text in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 粗体文本 for Bold Text, with related buyer language around 加粗文本 (bolded text), 更粗字体 (heavier typefaces), 显示与文字大小 (Display & Text Size under 辅助功能 → 无障碍), and 可读性 (readability). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 视力 or medical eye-exam claims that could imply clinical products.

Bold Text vs Increase Contrast — do not conflate

Increase Contrast strengthens button, icon, and separator borders — 增强对比度, 提高对比度. Bold Text makes system text heavier — 粗体文本, 加粗文本. If your English gallery shows an Increase Contrast toggle, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to 粗体文本 claims. See the Increase Contrast listing guide only if UI contrast boosts are your lead marketing claim.

Bold Text vs Dynamic Type and Larger Text — do not conflate

Dynamic Type and Larger Text scale font size — 动态字体, 更大字号, 字号可调. Bold Text changes typeface weight without enlarging text — 粗体文本. If your English gallery shows a text-size slider or "Supports Dynamic Type" badges, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to Bold Text claims unless that is what the frame depicts. See the Dynamic Type listing guide only if adjustable font size is your lead marketing claim.

Bold Text vs Reduce Transparency

Reduce Transparency makes sheet and menu backgrounds more opaque — reducing see-through blur. Bold Text makes system text bolder. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 降低透明度 when your English source only shows a Bold Text toggle. Each Display & Text Size toggle has its own buyer vocabulary.

Bold Text vs Display Accommodations color filters

Color filters, smart invert, and reduce white point live under Accessibility → Display & Text Size alongside Bold Text — but they are different features with different buyer intent. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 颜色滤镜 or 降低白点 when your English source only shows a Bold Text toggle. See the Display Accommodations listing guide only if color filters are your lead marketing claim.

Bold Text vs third-party font apps

Font marketplace apps sell custom typeface packs, font installation, and designer font browsing — different buyer intent from Apple's system Bold Text toggle. zh-Hans listing copy should describe Bold Text compatibility or heavier system text — not 字体商店 or custom font catalog positioning unless your English source already claims that product category.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Bold Text and readability search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 粗体文本, 加粗文本, and 更粗字体 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords or Increase Contrast terms like 增强对比度.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Bold Text" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Bold Text — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

AppLocale FAQ

Is Bold Text the same as Increase Contrast?

No. Bold Text makes system text heavier — 粗体文本, 加粗文本. Increase Contrast boosts UI element contrast for buttons, icons, and separators — 增强对比度, 提高对比度 — without changing font weight. See our Increase Contrast listing guide for UI contrast marketing copy.

Is Bold Text the same as Dynamic Type or Larger Text?

No. Dynamic Type and Larger Text market adjustable font size and scalable typography — 动态字体, 更大字号. Bold Text markets heavier system typefaces without enlarging text — 粗体文本. See our Dynamic Type listing guide for font-size scaling copy.

Is Bold Text the same as Reduce Transparency?

No. Reduce Transparency makes sheet and menu backgrounds more opaque — less see-through blur. Bold Text makes system text bolder — 粗体文本. Different Display & Text Size toggles with different buyer vocabulary.

Is Bold Text the same as Display Accommodations color filters?

No. Display Accommodations covers color filters, invert colors, and reduce white point — 颜色滤镜, 降低白点. Bold Text covers heavier system typefaces — 粗体文本. See our Display Accommodations listing guide for color-filter marketing copy.

Is Bold Text the same as a third-party font app?

No. Bold Text markets Apple's system-wide accessibility toggle under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size. Third-party font apps and custom typeface marketplaces are different product categories with different buyer intent.
